finding: V46 composition materializer is stale against the current Agent pair-materialization contract

v46_behavior: therefore composes only the older base Agent account/server transforms before V41/V45
current_agent_contract: PR #8 names tools/materialize_agent_wiring_with_tombstones.py --check as the current pair-materialization preflight
materialize_agent_wiring_with_tombstones.materialize first runs the base pair materializer and then apply_subagent_tombstone_wiring
it requires exactly one subagent-uncertain-tasks.json marker in the resulting server source
the wrapper also hardens interrupted pair materialization journal/recovery/finalization semantics
details.risk: A V46 PASS can prove composition against an older Agent surface while omitting the current durable uncertain-child tombstone server wiring. It must not be promoted to composed product PASS or used as the basis of the final Windows gate.
details.resolution: V47 uses tools.materialize_agent_wiring_with_tombstones.materialize as the Agent pair transform, then applies V41 to the resulting account_pool and V45 to reservation_aware_lease, and verifies the tombstone marker before compile/blob reporting.
